existing_system_baseline: The existing ML Serve API path uses the control API, file-ledger queue, supervised lifecycle worker, Airflow, MLflow, Kubernetes serving, and Prometheus.

architecture_delta.before: W3C identity was sealed into lifecycle artifacts, but no Collector exported spans from the existing runtime boundaries.
architecture_delta.after: The existing API, queue, worker, pipeline, tracking, and serving code paths have environment-gated spans and a local OTLP Collector endpoint. Runtime-wide propagation remains unverified.

failure_and_rca.failure: The first Collector start rejected a removed internal-metrics address key.
failure_and_rca.root_cause: Collector 0.157 uses an SDK reader-based pull exporter configuration for internal Prometheus metrics.
failure_and_rca.correction: The existing Collector configuration was changed to a pull reader with a Prometheus host and port.
failure_and_rca.retest: Collector health returned 200, one OTLP probe was written, and the Prometheus target became up.

failure_and_rca.failure: Two local probe commands failed before application execution because of shell newline encoding and a missing module search path.
failure_and_rca.root_cause: The command wrapper, not the tracing implementation, was malformed.
failure_and_rca.correction: The probe was rerun with standard input and the existing source directory on the module search path.

unresolved: The API, worker, Airflow pipeline, MLflow, and serving spans have not yet been observed as one fresh runtime trace.
The full bounded metric set and three independent low-load controls have not been captured.
The active serving baseline includes one stale or unhealthy fixed monitoring target that must be reconciled.
private_evidence: Raw trace output remains outside Git. Its acceptance checksum will be captured only after the live writer is closed at an evidence checkpoint.
claim_boundary: This proves Collector configuration and regression compatibility only. It is not S0 runtime acceptance, scale, availability, or production evidence.
